entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand tracker. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back. Now.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To start, could you please provide me with your order number?
It's VF886-0-12. And don't give me the runaround. I've had it with this thing.

Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 20th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
What does it matter? I don't want it! It's not what I expected. I want to return it. Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager?

I understand your frustration, and I can definitely help you. I just need to ask these questions to follow the correct procedure. I see it's not a technical issue, so let me just check the return eligibility based on the delivery date.
You'd better. I'll post reviews everywhere if you try to pull something.

Okay, I've just reviewed everything. I had to double-check because our return **policy** can differ between products. For some of our newer releases, there's a very strict window due to **hygiene** and **sanitation** standards for items with prolonged skin contact. For those, after about 20 days it's simply **too late** to process a return.
Are you telling me I can't return this? I knew it! Get me your supervisor!

Not at all, sir. I was just explaining why I had to verify the specific model. The good news is that your VeloBand GPS Tracker falls under our standard 10-day return policy. Since it was delivered 29 days ago, you are unfortunately outside the window for a full refund.
Oh. So... you're going to take it back? For a full refund?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return process for you. I am sending an email to the address on file right now. It will contain a prepaid shipping label and instructions on how to send the VeloBand back to us. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
Okay. Wow. That's... actually what I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's it. Thanks for your help, Sarah.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit and have a great day.
